list.title: Lease
list.emptyBody: When your building's office sends you a lease, it appears here

view.title: Lease · unit {unit}
view.subtitle: {building} · managed by {operator}
view.signBody: Read the lease and sign it here; the office signs after you
view.waitingBody: You have signed. The lease comes into force when the office signs too — you will get a LINE message

rules.title: Building rules
rules.lead: These rules are part of your lease. Please confirm you have read them
rules.checkbox: I have read the building rules
rules.acknowledged: You confirmed the building rules on {date}

sign.unavailableBody: This lease cannot be signed right now. Contact your building's office
sign.alreadySigned: You have already signed this lease

read.title: Read the lease
read.lead: Scroll to the end before you sign. The full lease (PDF) is the binding text
read.binding: The standard residential lease of the Office of the Consumer Protection Board applies; the PDF holds every clause
read.scrollHint: Scroll the lease above to the end to continue
read.confirm: I have read the whole lease and agree to it
read.updated: The lease was updated just now. The current version is shown above — read it again before you sign.

draw.title: Your signature
draw.lead: Sign inside the box with your finger
draw.label: Your signature
draw.upload: Use a photo of my signature
draw.tooLarge: This picture is too large. Draw your signature or choose a smaller photo
draw.uploadHint: Can't draw? Use a photo or scan of your signature instead

otp.title: Confirm with the SMS code
otp.sending: Sending a code to your phone…
otp.wrong: {count, plural, =0 {Wrong code. No tries left — ask for a new code} one {Wrong code. # try left} other {Wrong code. # tries left}}
otp.resendIn: Send a new code in {seconds} s

done.title: Lease signed
done.activeBody: The office has signed too. The signed copy is with your documents
done.waitingBody: The lease comes into force when the office signs. You will get a LINE message
done.hashBody: The SHA-256 of the exact document you signed, kept as evidence

noticeForm.title: Give notice to move out
noticeForm.lead: Tell the office in writing at least 30 days before you leave
noticeForm.dateHint: The earliest date you can choose is {date}
noticeForm.dateHintNone: At least 30 days from today; the office's system checks the date
noticeForm.unavailableBody: Only the lessee of a lease in force can give notice here. Contact your building's office
noticeForm.alreadyGiven: You have already given notice on this lease

confirm.title: Check your notice
confirm.body: You will move out of unit {unit}, {building}, on {date}
confirm.final: Once sent, the notice is recorded and the office is told. To change it, talk to the office

done.title: Notice sent
done.body: You move out of unit {unit} on {date}
done.document: The notice is kept with your documents. The office will contact you about the move-out inspection and your deposit

lead.rent_increase: Your landlord gives the rent for the next lease. Your current rent does not change.
lead.renewal_offer: Your landlord offers to renew your lease on the terms below, with no renewal fee.
lead.non_renewal: Your landlord will not renew the lease. It ends as agreed.
lead.termination: Your landlord ends the lease for the reason given in the full letter.
lead.late_payment: The amounts below are overdue. This letter does not end your lease.

after.rent_increase: Questions? Contact your landlord as shown in the letter.
after.renewal_offer: To renew, answer your landlord by the date shown; the new lease will come to you to sign in the app.
after.non_renewal: Please hand the room back by the end date. Your landlord will inspect it with you and return the deposit as the lease says.
after.termination: Nobody may cut your water or electricity or change the locks. If you disagree, contact your landlord or the OCPB (1166).
after.late_payment: Pay with the Thai QR on the bill. If you have already paid, there is nothing else to do.

certificates.title: Rent payment certificate
certificates.linkHint: For a visa, a bank or an employer
certificates.lead: Ask {name} here. When it is issued, we will tell you in LINE.
certificates.empty: You have not asked for a certificate yet.
certificates.waiting: Asked on {date}; waiting for the landlord.
certificates.declined: The landlord could not issue it: {reason}
certificates.openBody: One request at a time. Once the landlord answers this one, you can ask again.
certificates.unavailableBody: You can ask for a certificate once the lease has started.

form.title: Ask for a new certificate
form.lead: Covers the payments of the last 12 months (not before the lease began), with any balance due.
form.languageHint: Embassies and foreign banks usually want English.
form.noteHint: Optional — for example, the date you need it by

inspections.title: Inspection reports
inspections.signedBoth: You and the landlord both signed this report. It is the evidence when the deposit is refunded
inspections.pleaseCheck: Look at every line and photo. If something is not right, message the landlord before signing

countersign.title: Sign the report
countersign.lead: Sign to confirm the unit is as this report says
countersign.done: Signed — the landlord was told in LINE
countersign.noteHint: For example, a scratch that was already there. The landlord sees this note and the photos with the report
